mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, target_role, publisher_no, publisher_name) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{targetRole}, #{publisherNo}, #{publisherName})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, target_role, publisher_no, publisher_name, NOW() as create_time FROM notice WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, title, content, target_role, publisher_no, publisher_name, NOW() as create_time FROM notice
AND (target_role = #{targetRole} OR target_role = 0)
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, title, content, target_role, publisher_no, publisher_name, NOW() as create_time FROM notice WHERE target_role = 9 ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
